reason: Keep only training questions with all annotated reference messages present in their linked raw histories.
scope_note: The current criterion is complete literal same-role reference-message presence. It does not reproduce the former labeling workflow strict-gold eligibility test, which reported 18,526 eligible questions.
question_embeddings: Rows filtered in their original order; retained vector values and completion markers verified identical.
retrieval_scores: Excluded question rows removed; every retained score row preserved byte-for-byte.

initial_exclusion.reason: Upstream dataset issue: reference snippets absent from histories under the labeling workflow strict gold-matching rules.

complete_reference_filter.matching_rule: Every annotated user/assistant reference message must exactly match a message with the same role and content in the question-linked raw 32K history. Reference lists must be nonempty and contain nonempty text. Empty reference turns are permitted only when the identical empty turn is also present in the raw history. Matching does not require contiguous turns.
